observed_behavior: Conditional fields follow the selected parent answer; dependent options are restricted to the matching choice set.
Optional sections and bounded repeatable rows render and are reviewed explicitly.
Sensitive controls are presented for manual review without collecting an answer or revealing the original field label or choices.
Reviewed answers and enabled optional sections persist in profile/application/fingerprint-scoped sessionStorage and restore after reload; review approvals reset.
The connected browser flow made only local GET requests; no answer API write, employer form fill, egress, or application submission occurred.
limitations: This is a local synthetic mock-ATS workflow; no live employer or ATS form was contacted.
Draft answers live only in the browser tab session and are not durably stored by the server.
Full Python repository suite, PostgreSQL validation, hosted checks, and live ATS validation were NOT_RUN.
Requirement MJ-REQ-133 and GitHub issue #134 remain PARTIAL/OPEN; external application submission remains OFF.
